bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission shall take the necessary measures to ensure that the Commission is able to take the necessary measures.
texto: It indicates the material or data that serve as the starting point: substantive + **をもとに**. **この データ を もとに、けいかく を たてます** (from this data, I will draw up a plan).

bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission has not considered that, in the light of the above, it is not possible to use the information provided by the Commission.
texto: It presents the basis or criterion that supports an action: substantive + **にもとづいて**. **きそく に もとづいて、判断します** (we will decide according to the rules). The difference with **をもとに** depends on the context; it is not an absolute opposition.

をもとに es más formal.
